question: CₙH₂ₙ belongs to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __Unsaturated hydrocarbo**n.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unsaturated hydrocarbon**

 
 
• **​**Organic compounds known as** unsaturated hydrocarbons **are characterized by the presence of a **double or triple bond** between two carbon atoms that are adjacent to one another and are entirely composed of **hydrogen and carbon.**
 
• The position of the** double or triple bond **is either described by a number written before the compound's name in the** IUPAC nomenclature** of unsaturated hydrocarbons (as in 2,4 pentadiene) or by a number written before the suffix, such as **"-ene" **or** "-yne," **(as in pent-2-ene).
 
• Except for **aromatic hydrocarbons**, these kinds of hydrocarbons are **very reactive** and frequently undergo addition reactions with alcohols, elemental halogens, hydrogen halides, and other compounds.
 
• **Alkenes, alkynes, and aromatic hydrocarbons** are all types of unsaturated hydrocarbons that can be categorized by the types of bonds they contain.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Uses of Unsaturated hydrocarbons**

 
 
• **Alkenes** can be used to make mustard gas, a poisonous gas used in chemical warfare.
 
• In the production of** plastics,** unsaturated hydrocarbons are extremely useful organic compounds.
 
• **Alcohol** and other industrial chemicals use **alkenes** in their manufacturing process.
 
• As general **anesthetics**, some unsaturated hydrocarbons are utilized.
